title: Who carries the review load
description: For each repo, the share of review+merge work in the selected period done by the single busiest person who can merge — committer or maintainer. 'top role' is whether the busiest is a committer or maintainer; 'top %' is their share, 'top-2 %' the top two combined. Highest concentration first; repos with under 20 review+merge actions in the selected period are omitted.
